question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Recede
solution:
The correct answer is '**Advance**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Recede**' describes the action of moving back or withdrawing. (पीछे हटना)

 
 
• **Example**: The floodwaters will **recede **in the next few days.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym here is '**advance**'. '**Advance**' refers to moving forward or making progress. (आगे बढ़ना)
 
 
• **Example**: **Advance **planning can help you achieve your goals effectively.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for '**recede**' is '**advance**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: '**Argue**' means to give reasons or cite evidence in support of an idea, action, or theory, often with the implication of persuading others to share one's view. (तर्क करना)
 
• Option 3: '**Ransack**' means to go hurriedly through (a place) stealing things and causing damage. (लूटना)
 
• Option 4: '**Irritate**' means to annoy someone. (चिढ़ाना)
